svg.title: Ultimate Fish endgame tablebase outcomes
svg.desc: Three grids summarize single-piece, same-team two-piece, and opposing two-piece endgames.
svg.text: Ultimate Fish · Endgame Tablebase Grouped by Material
Percent ranges show the row side starting then the opponent starting · Win/Loss Cells indicate the result for the row

Reachable positions only · Immediate stalemates and forced one-ply/tactical material simplifications are excluded · Prince: cont=0 starting boundaries only · Copycat: starts with one mirrored pair · Devil: own spawned Minions only; starts on ranks 1-3
